Who We Are

Welcome to TELUS Digital, where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture.

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across eight core service areas: Digital Product Consulting, Digital Marketing Services, Data & AI, Strategy Consulting, Enterprise Technology, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Engineering, and QA & Test Engineering.

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are, all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location

This role will be based out of one of our major US or Canada
office locations: Charlottesville, VA, Durham, NC, Columbus, OH, Boston, MA, Toronto, ON, or Vancouver, BC.

The Opportunity

This business unit specializes in data-driven solutions and strategic AI implementation. We help our clients unlock the full potential of their data and transform their business through innovative, AI-powered strategies.

Our Managing Director, Data, AI & Cloud, will lead our Data & AI advisory, AI solutions, Data platforms, and cloud transformation capabilities. In this role, you will be responsible for driving the growth, profitability, and success of the practice. You will provide strategic guidance, lead cross-functional teams, and deliver outstanding client value across our global footprint. The Managing Director, Data, AI & Cloud will have P&L responsibility and will play a critical role in shaping our company's overall vision, strategy, and growth.

This is an exceptional opportunity for a talented and results-oriented leader to make a significant impact in shaping our company's future and driving data-driven solutions in the evolving digital landscape. If you are passionate about data, AI, and strategic consulting, we invite you to apply and join our high-performing team.

To learn more about our AI practice: https://www.telusdigital.com/solutions/enterprise-ai

To learn more about our Cloud practice: https://www.telusdigital.com/solutions/enterprise-technology-modernization/cloud-services

Strategy and Leadership:

Collaborate with the executive leadership team to define the company's Data, AI & Cloud vision, strategy, and goals
Drive growth by identifying emerging trends, market opportunities, and industry best practices
Lead the planning, development, and execution of the Data, AI & Cloud strategic roadmap

Assume overall accountability for the financial performance of the Data, AI & Cloud consulting practice
Partner with Practice Leaders and Business Development to continue to grow managed accounts
In partnership with Business Development, develop and implement effective revenue generation strategies to meet or exceed annual revenue targets

Build and lead high-performing teams, including Data Engineers, Data Scientists, AI Strategists, and AI Engineers
Foster a culture of excellence, innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning within the Data, AI & Cloud teams globally and more broadly through the Practice Advisor team

Client Engagement And Delivery

Partner with clients to identify their business challenges and design tailored Data, AI & Cloud solutions
Oversee the delivery of high-quality data-driven insights, models, and strategic recommendations
Provide thought leadership and build trusted advisor relationships with key client stakeholders

Experience

10+ years of relevant leadership and team management experience within a top-tier management consultancy (Partner-level) or global and publicly traded enterprise (VP, SVP, or C-level) with a focus on AI, Data Engineering, Data Science, or Related Fields
Leads a line of business for a mid-size to large consultancy (i.e., office, industry, etc.)
Leadership experience in technology consulting, project management, and executive partnerships
Clear and tested experience in leading cross-functional teams and managing P&L responsibilities

In-depth knowledge of Data Engineering, Data Science, and AI technologies and tools
Familiarity with emerging trends, best practices, and advancements in Data, AI & Cloud applications
Track record of being a dynamic decision-maker and having adaptability in a quickly changing environment

Exceptional leadership and people management skills, inspiring and motivating cross-functional teams

Director, CX AI Delivery

Who We Are

Welcome to TELUS Digital — where innovation drives impact at a global scale. As an award-winning digital product consultancy and the digital division of TELUS, one of Canada’s largest telecommunications providers, we design and deliver transformative customer experiences through cutting-edge technology, agile thinking, and a people-first culture

With a global team across North America, South America, Central America, Europe, Africa, and APAC, we offer end-to-end expertise across eight core service areas: Digital Product Consulting, Digital Marketing Services, Data & AI, Strategy Consulting, Business Operations Modernization, Enterprise Applications, Cloud Engineering, and QA & Test Engineering.

From mobile apps and websites to voice UI, chatbots, AI, customer service, and in-store solutions, TELUS Digital enables seamless, trusted, and digitally powered experiences that meet customers wherever they are — all backed by the secure infrastructure and scale of our multi-billion-dollar parent company.

Location & Flexibility

This role will operate remotely in the United States
or Canada
OR be based out of one of our major North American office locations - Charlottesville, VA, Durham, NC, Columbus, OH, Boston, MA, Toronto, ON, or Vancouver, BC.

This role may involve travel of up to 25% to contact center and client locations.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Director, CX AI Delivery
: a consultant and delivery expert who can turn complex contact center and AI programs into predictable, measurable outcomes. You will lead delivery across our CX AI portfolio, spanning Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) platforms, conversational and agentic AI, agent assist, and CX intelligence, and serve as a trusted advisor to client executives. You will manage a portfolio of client engagements (generally ~$15–20M in revenue), directly lead delivery, product, and engineering leaders, and step in to stabilize and recover programs when needed.

This is a delivery-first leadership role with an AI lens. You will bring the rigor of a seasoned delivery executive together with a working command of how AI is changing CX: from AI-driven routing and virtual agents to copilots, knowledge, and agentic automation. You will help clients adopt these capabilities responsibly, at scale, and in iterative releases that get value into production quickly. You will also help evaluate vendor and partner solutions and decide how and when new tools enter the ecosystem.

This position reports to the Managing Director, CX AI Delivery and typically manages 8–12 direct reports, including senior managers, managers, and principal-level delivery and technical leaders. It is primarily evaluated on delivery success, client and team feedback, forecast accuracy, portfolio profitability, and growth of key accounts. This is an opportunistically billable position.

Responsibilities

Strategic Account Governance & Growth

Be the executive partner. Act as the primary escalation point and strategic advisor for client executives, ensuring TELUS Digital is viewed as a “Doctor” (consultative partner), not a “Waiter” (order taker).
Run portfolio health. Drive the commercial success of a ~$15–20M portfolio, leading Quarterly Business Reviews that connect delivery progress to the client’s long-term CX and business goals.
Grow organically. Identify expansion opportunities in existing accounts by understanding client pain points and bringing a relevant point of view on CX and AI. Support renewals, upsell, and expansion in partnership with strategic sales and customer success teams.
Extend into managed services and advisory as the practice matures: shape Day 2 support models, operational readiness, and advisory engagements that keep clients engaged after go-live.

Delivery Excellence & Risk Mitigation

Lead a global, multidisciplinary team across multiple concurrent workstreams, ensuring product, engineering, and delivery leaders operate as a cohesive unit to deliver measurable outcomes.
Manage risk proactively. Identify “red” and “yellow” programs early; step into recovery situations to provide clarity, reset expectations, and stabilize teams and client relationships.
Push for iterative delivery. Favor smaller releases and faster cycles over big-bang launches, especially for AI capabilities where learning in production is essential.
Optimize delivery models, balancing onshore/offshore teams, automation, and repeatable assets to improve margins and scalability.
Manage vendor and partner ecosystems. Work with CCaaS and AI platform partners (e.g., Genesys, Google, AWS, Zendesk, Five9, ElevenLabs, Cresta, Parloa) to deliver joint solutions as well as surrounding services in the client ecosystem.
Partner on pre-sales. Support the commercial team to shape innovative solutions and lead scoping, estimation, and handoffs into delivery so engagements start with clear requirements and goals.

Leadership & Talent Development

Coach and mentor delivery, product, and engineering leaders on leading their own teams and navigating complex client dynamics.
Build a high-performance culture with regular 1:1s and performance reviews grounded in radical candor and growth, delivering feedback upward, across, and down with grace and clarity.
Raise the bar on talent. Participate in senior-level hiring, contribute to the Delivery Playbook, and build career paths and skill development (including AI and platform certification pipelines).

Operational & Financial Stewardship

Own portfolio financials: gross margin, utilization, and effective billable rates.
Forecast accurately. Maintain precise revenue and resource forecasts so the business can plan hiring and growth with confidence.
Influence with data. Use reporting language, data visualization, and storytelling to influence internal and external decisions and inspire confidence in stakeholders.
Collaborate across the business with peers and practice leaders to improve internal processes and operational efficiency, and bring energy to moments that matter: new relationships, key presentations, and recovery situations.

Qualifications

10+ years in the technology industry, including 4+ years in a senior leadership role in a professional services, consulting, or agency environment.
Proven record managing a diverse portfolio of client accounts (ideally $10M+ in annual revenue) with a focus on retention and organic growth.
Experience delivering large-scale CX or contact center transformations that influenced VP- and C-level decision making.
Working knowledge of how AI is applied in CX: conversational and voice AI, agent assist and copilots, AI-driven routing, knowledge and content for AI, and CX intelligence; ability to discuss architecture, risk, and ROI credibly with both technical and executive audiences.
Hands-on delivery experience with one or more leading CCaaS or CX AI platforms (e.g., Genesys, Amazon Connect, Zendesk, Google); platform certifications and experience across multiple verticals are a plus.
Deep understanding of the SDLC and Agile delivery, with a track record of leading complex, custom-built software solutions from discovery to launch, and comfort with iterative, experiment-driven delivery.
Experience managing and coaching leaders across Product, Engineering, and Delivery, and leading large, globally distributed teams.
Strong command of professional services metrics, including gross margin, utilization, forecast accuracy, and effective billable rates.
Exceptional ability to navigate “recovery situations” and high-stakes client conversations with poise, clarity, and a solution-oriented mindset.
Ability to translate complex delivery data into compelling narratives for QBRs and executive stakeholders.
Understanding of regulatory requirements in contact center operations (e.g., PCI, HIPAA, TCPA, PIPEDA) is a plus.

About Us

Embrace Software acquires mission-critical businesses and helps them thrive for the long term. With 17+ acquisitions across healthcare, industrial, financial services, education, legal, and public sector, our portfolio runs inside 16% of the Fortune 500, 45+ state agencies, and 450+ banks and credit unions. Job Description

This is a remote position.

Role Overview

This is an opportunity to work directly with the CEO of Embrace as Chief of Staff, leading strategic and high-impact operational projects across the portfolio, from growing and optimising businesses to strategy. You will work closely with portfolio company CEOs and the Operating Leaders across our industry groups.

Core Mandate

Partner with the CEO on strategic and high-impact operational priorities
Grow and optimize portfolio companies, applying and building Embrace's value creation playbooks
Scale AI and operating best practices across the portfolio for measurable ROI
Build the experience to take on senior leadership in the portfolio

Key Responsibilities

1. Grow & Optimize

Lead growth work with portfolio CEOs on pricing, go-to-market, and retention.
Diagnose underperformance and reset cost structure, organization, and cash flow.
Use AI and data to sharpen diagnostics on churn risk, pricing, and cost benchmarks.
Set clear KPIs for each initiative and turn what works into repeatable playbooks.

2. Portfolio Operations & AI Transformation

Set a consistent operating cadence and KPI dashboards across the portfolio.
Drive end-to-end AI automation across product, services, and internal workflows.
Prioritize AI use cases by ROI, track adoption, and build AI fluency across teams.

3. Strategy & Office of the CEO

Support corporate strategy, annual planning, and board and investor materials.
Run the leadership team's operating rhythm and lead special projects for the CEO.

4. Change Management

Lead the people side of transformation, including restructurings, leadership transitions, underperformance, and resistance to change.
Handle difficult conversations with fairness, discretion, and maturity.
Build trust with portfolio CEOs, Operating Leaders, and functional leaders.

How You'll Spend Your Time

Operations, including growth, optimization, and portfolio performance (~80%); strategy and the Office of the CEO (~20%).

Path to Leadership

You will work closely with the CEO and be mentored by Embrace's Operating Leaders. High performers will have the opportunity to move into senior leadership roles across the portfolio, with the long-term goal of leading an Embrace company as CEO.

What Success Looks Like (18–24 Months)

Measurable revenue growth and EBITDA improvement in the companies you support.
AI live in core workflows, with measurable productivity and ROI gains.
Growth and productivity playbooks driven hands-on at portfolio companies.
Short feedback loops and fast iteration on every initiative.
Change led while keeping key talent and the trust of teams and customers.
Ready to take on a senior leadership role in the portfolio.

8+ years of progressive experience across operating roles, management consulting, or private equity operations, including hands-on operating leadership roles.

Industry experience in financial services, healthcare, legal, or manufacturing.

The Director, Workforce Readiness leads strategic change and workforce readiness efforts for technology-enabled initiatives that materially change how work is performed across McKesson. The role partners across corporate functions, technology teams, workforce intelligence, HR, and business stakeholders to help leaders understand how work is changing, anticipate workforce and organizational impacts, redesign work where appropriate, and prepare employees and leaders for new ways of working. The Director serves as a strategic change leader and trusted advisor to senior leaders, shaping workforce readiness, work redesign, talent mobility, capability development, and change approaches associated with AI, automation, digital platforms, process modernization, and other initiatives that materially change work. The Organizational Setting

The Air Transport Bureau (ATB) carries out activities under ICAO’s Strategic Goals of “ Every Flight Is Safe and Secure” , “ Aviation Is Environmentally Sustainable” , “ Aviation Delivers Seamless, Accessible, and Reliable Mobility for All” and “ The Economic Development of Air Transport Assures the Delivery of Economic Prosperity and Societal Well-Being for All” . It also contributes to the Goal of “ No Country Left Behind” . It is responsible for the provision of expert assistance required by the Assembly, Council, Air Transport Committee (ATC), Aviation Security Committee (ASC), Ad Hoc Cybersecurity Coordination Committee (AHCCC), Committee on Joint Support of Air Navigation Services (JSC), Climate and Environment Committee (CEC), Committee on Aviation Environmental Protection (CAEP) and the specialized conferences, divisional, panel and working group meetings related to the Organization’s Strategic Goals. The Bureau assists in developing, updating, and promoting the implementation of Standards and Recommended Practices (SARPs) in Annexes 9, 16 and 17, air transport policies and guidance (such as air transport regulation, economics of airports and air navigation services, and funding of aviation infrastructure) as well as the specifications for machine readable travel documents.

The Bureau is also charged with the development of environment-related policies and measures and assistance for States to prepare and implement their action plans for CO2 emissions reduction activities. In addition, the Bureau implements the ICAO Global Aviation Security Plan (GASeP), the Universal Security Audit Programme (USAP) and assistance for States in rectifying deficiencies identified by the USAP and implements an ICAO Traveller Identification Programme (ICAO TRIP) Strategy. Furthermore, it maintains and provides access to civil aviation data/statistics and forecasts. Data on acts of unlawful interference and environmental protection (noise and emissions) are also maintained in the Bureau. The Bureau works with other offices of the Organization including Regional Offices, performs liaison and coordinates on the above-mentioned issues with all the United Nations bodies, other international organizations and regional civil aviation organizations.

The Director, Air Transport Bureau (ATB) reports directly to the Secretary General and is responsible for directing and managing the execution of the Bureau work programmes and activities. The Director formulates ATB’s overall strategies, policies and business plan; oversees the development and implementation of the work programme of the Bureau and directs a team of experts in order to provide sound advice and assistance to the Secretary General, the governing bodies and Secretariat of ICAO, and other relevant entities on a wide range of air transport policy and operational issues. Serves as ICAO representative on UN System, and other international and regional bodies dealing with matters related to air transport,

Performs other related duties, as assigned
.

An advanced level university degree (Master’s Degree or equivalent Master’s-level university degree) in an aviation-related field, including scientific or technical discipline, management, administration, economics, law or a related area is required.

Over 15 years of progressively responsible professional experience, reaching executive level in the planning, management and coordination of activities in air transport or related area.
At least five (5) years of experience at senior managerial level, overseeing the planning and implementation of civil aviation programmes and projects in a public or private sector organization.
Experience at the international level or dealing with aviation matters crossing national boundaries, including high-level negotiation with government authorities.
Managerial experience at the senior executive level with proven leadership ability to plan and direct large-scale civil aviation programmes/projects, in a multicultural environment.

Experience in public speaking and media engagement.

Languages

Fluent reading, writing and speaking abilities in English.

A working knowledge of any other language of the Organization (Arabic, Chinese, French, Russian, Spanish).

of our Ground Engineering & Materials business across British Columbia (BC) and Yukon.

Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Earth & Environment, BC & Yukon, the Vice President will lead a diverse regional business spanning geotechnical engineering, materials engineering, laboratory services, field services and construction materials
. The role carries accountability for the growth, performance, technical excellence and long-term health of the business.

s across WSP.

, while setting clear expectations and building a culture of accountability, collaboration and technical excellence.

.

, drive operational performance, build stronger connections across WSP and position Ground Engineering & Materials as a trusted partner in solving our clients’ increasingly complex geotechnical engineering challenges.

Your Impact

Set a clear and compelling vision for the BC & Yukon business, translating regional and national priorities into a focused strategy that drives performance, growth, and long-term success.

Identify emerging trends, evolving client needs, and new opportunities across markets, sectors, services, geographies, and client relationships.

Lead financial and operational performance, including budgeting, revenue growth, profitability, utilization, forecasting, resource planning, and workforce deployment.
Establish and monitor key performance indicators that drive accountability, operational excellence, and informed decision-making.

Provide oversight of business risk and commercial performance, while serving as executive sponsor for strategic initiatives, projects, and key client opportunities.
Foster an inclusive, high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, technical excellence, and professional growth.
Support recruitment, retention, succession planning, and the development of future leaders while promoting collaboration and knowledge sharing across teams and regions.
Build strong relationships with clients, industry associations, regulatory agencies, Indigenous communities, and other key stakeholders.
Demonstrate visible leadership in health, safety, environment, quality, and integrity, embedding these principles throughout the business and promoting proactive risk management and continuous improvement.
Contribute to the overall direction and success of the BC & Yukon Earth & Environment business as a member of the regional leadership team.

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Geoscience, or a related discipline.
Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation or equivalent professional registration.
15+ years of progressive leadership experience within geotechnical engineering, materials engineering, construction services, consulting, or a related field.

Exceptional leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Flexible work, real balance – we recognize the importance of balance in our lives and encourage you to prioritize the balance in yours.

Starting at $200,880

Explore Limitless Possibilities

we believe in the power of the professional travel advisor. We represent over $4.5 billion in annual travel sales. Equally important is our philanthropy. Range Foundation channels 10% of group profits to social impact. From exploration grants, improved access to education, new discoveries on sea and land, cultural infrastructure, and helping our global neighbors in times of need — we are investing to build a better future.

About The Role

This is a hands-on senior finance leadership role for someone who operates at the intersection of strategy, analytics, and execution. You’re as comfortable building a complex multi-entity model from scratch as you are presenting the story behind the numbers to the executive team.

As Director, FP&A, you will own the analytical engine that supports decision-making across Range Group’s portfolio of travel brands — leading enterprise planning and forecasting, managing a small team, and working directly with senior leadership to evaluate opportunities, navigate risks, and drive performance.

What You’ll Do

Financial Modelling & Planning

Build, maintain, and continuously improve financial models covering consolidated Group performance, brand-level P&Ls, cash flow forecasting, and scenario analysis.
Own the Group-level cash flow tracker and EBITDA bridging model, ensuring accuracy and timeliness week over week.
Lead the annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes across the organization.
Support ad hoc financial analysis — acquisition modelling, business case development, and covenant compliance.
Drive continuous improvement in financial planning frameworks, forecasting methodologies, and analytical tools.

Performance Management & Executive Insights

Own enterprise-wide performance reporting — financial reviews, KPI dashboards, executive scorecards, and variance commentary.
Lead monthly and quarterly business reviews with senior leadership.
Translate financial results into clear, decision-ready insights that prompt action.
Identify and proactively flag emerging risks, opportunities, and performance trends across the portfolio.

Strategic Business Partnership

Partner with executive and business leaders to align financial plans with strategic priorities and growth objectives.
Evaluate investments, business initiatives, and strategic opportunities through modelling and scenario analysis.
Provide financial leadership on strategic initiatives, business cases, and investment decisions.
Support executive and Board reporting requirements.

Treasury & Foreign Exchange Management

Own foreign exchange exposure tracking, reporting, and scenario analysis across the Group's multi-currency operations.
Partner with treasury, banking partners, and external advisors to evaluate foreign exchange risks and mitigation strategies.
Assess the financial impact of currency fluctuations on forecasts, budgets, cash flow, and business performance.
Develop recommendations and decision-support materials for leadership regarding FX risk management and capital planning.
Monitor market trends and currency movements, proactively identifying risks and opportunities that may impact business performance.

Team Leadership & Capability Building

Lead a small finance team — including a Finance Manager and intern — as a player-coach: owning models and analysis end-to-end while delegating and developing where appropriate.
Foster a high-performance, analytically rigorous culture within the team.
Support ERP and reporting tool improvements from a finance data and output perspective.
Champion the evolution of finance from a reporting function to a true strategic business partner.

What You’ll Bring

8+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, Strategic Finance, or Finance Business Partnering — with a track record of owning complex models in a multi-entity environment.
Advanced Excel skills — non-negotiable. You build models from scratch, structure them for auditability, and are fast and precise in the tool.
Strong accounting foundation: you understand how the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement connect inside a model.
Proven experience leading enterprise budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning processes.
Experience analyzing foreign exchange exposure, multi-currency financial impacts, and scenario modelling within a corporate FP&A, finance, or strategic finance environment.
Strong executive presence, comfortable presenting to senior leadership and capable of influencing and constructively challenging stakeholders.
Experience in multi-entity and multi-currency operating environments.
CPA designation strongly preferred; candidates without the designation will be considered where technical skills and experience are strong.
Background in travel, technology, hospitality, or another fast-paced, multi-brand environment is an asset.

Who You Are

You are a builder. You prefer to own models end-to-end and take pride in work that is structured, auditable, and built to last.
You are intellectually curious and detail-oriented, but able to zoom out and connect the numbers to a broader business narrative.
You operate well with ambiguity and can manage competing priorities without losing accuracy or composure.
You are a collaborative leader who still wants to be close to the work — energized by doing, not just directing.
You communicate with a low-ego, peer-level style — credible with senior stakeholders, collegial with the broader team, and proactive about surfacing issues.

Why Join Range Group

This is a rare opportunity to bridge corporate finance and executive strategy in a multi-brand travel and technology portfolio. You’ll have genuine influence — shaping how capital is allocated, how performance is communicated, and how the finance function evolves as the company grows.

The role carries real complexity: multi-entity consolidations, multi-currency exposure, and a direct reporting line to the Chief Finance Officer. You’ll lead a small team and have the space to build the frameworks and processes that become the foundation for the company’s next phase.

Working with senior officials, industry, other government ministries and federal partners, the Executive Director will develop strategies that promote Alberta in domestic and international markets, build relationships with investors and buyers, and help address complex barriers affecting investment and trade. As leader of the Export and Investment Attraction Branch, the Executive Director sets strategic direction, oversees branch resources and financial management, and leads an inclusive, collaborative and high-performing team in advancing government priorities.

The Executive Director will be accountable for the effective management of branch resources, budgets, people and priorities. The position provides leadership to directors and staff, establishes a clear vision and direction for the branch, promotes collaboration across teams, and ensures employees have the information, resources and support required to deliver on government priorities.

Qualifications

Your background includes significant related senior management experience with strengths in strategic leadership, relationship building and achieving results through others. You are a strategic and systems thinker with strong communication and influencing skills and a proven ability to build collaborative partnerships across government, industry and other organizations. Experience leading change, developing and implementing strategies, managing public-sector resources and providing sound advice on complex issues will position you for success.

A bachelor’s degree in business, international studies, marketing/communications, or a related discipline is preferred.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a high-caliber Retail Planning Change Agent
to build and modernize our global planning and allocation engine from the ground up. Reporting directly to executive leadership, you will enjoy complete operational autonomy, high visibility, and a true seat at the strategic table—without micromanagement. This is a defining opportunity to architect the modern infrastructure that fuels our next chapter of growth.

Your Daily Adventures

Forget legacy spreadsheets and traditional planning. As Senior Director of Planning & Allocation
, you will act as the core architect of our global inventory engine—leveraging predictive modeling, algorithmic markdowns, and AI to maximize gross margin across Full Price, Outlet, E-commerce, and Wholesale.

Financial Planning & OTB Governance: Own top-down Merchandise Financial Plans (MFP) across all 4 channels, serving as the final authority on Open-To-Buy (OTB) budgets and aligning inventory investments directly with P&L targets.
Algorithmic Inventory & Allocation: Oversee single-pool allocation across ~150 doors, using behavior-based store clustering and predictive modeling to eliminate size breaks, capture lost sales, and boost stock turn velocity.
Predictive Trading & Margin Protection: Drive high-velocity weekly WSSI trading cadences, shifting from reactive promotions to automated, predictive markdown schedules that prevent margin leaks.
AI Platform & Process Architecture: Lead the implementation of the Intelo AI platform, replacing siloed spreadsheets with a single source of truth and establishing a disciplined pre- and in-season corporate cadence.
Team Leadership & Transformation: Direct and mentor a team of 9-10 professionals in category pods, upskilling their capabilities from manual data entry into high-impact strategic advisory roles.

Your Toolkit

12-18 years of progressive retail planning experience in premium apparel/lifestyle specialty retail, including 3+ years in direct leadership.
Deep expertise in single-pool omnichannel models across retail, e-commerce, and wholesale.
Mastery of MFP, OTB governance, WSSI cadences, and algorithmic markdown optimization.
Proven experience leading, mentoring, and upskilling planning and allocation teams.
Experience with advanced AI-driven planning solutions (Intelo, Blue Yonder, o9, etc.).
Commercially sharp with strong executive presence and experience presenting directly to C-suite leadership.

On-site gym and on-site cafeteria / bistro with subsidized meals, including breakfast and lunch.

Six (6) wellness days and your birthday off, on us
Comprehensive group Insurance coverage, including health, dental, vision
An Employee/Family Assistance Program (EFAP) to support you through life's challenges
Career advancement opportunities within a fast-growing brand spearheading the AI transformation across our industry.
Team events and great opportunities to socialize
Surrounded by a passionate and inspiring team
Last but not least, let us not forget the swag you can get with an amazing employee discount
